raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MAR-SecondIdentityTargetingSocialProtection",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Inaccurate or incomplete identity data due to inconsistent legacy databases may cause exclusion and duplicate records.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Use biometric deduplication, phased fresh enrollment, continuous data validation and automated reconciliation to ensure data quality.",
      "evidence": "existing databases had inconsistent quality and data formats... risk of propagating these inaccuracies"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Insufficient institutional capacity and governance for the new National Registry Agency (NRA) could delay operationalization.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define clear governance charter, recruit key staff, provide capacity‑building, and maintain IMSC oversight of NRA setup.",
      "evidence": "operationalization of the NRA will be essential... establishing governance agreements with programs and other actors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Vulnerable populations in remote/rural areas may be excluded from NPR and SR enrollment.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Expand mobile units, satellite connectivity, targeted communication campaigns, and monitor enrollment gaps for corrective action.",
      "evidence": "mobile units and satellite connection equipment... facilitate the enrollment of people living in isolated areas... risk of exclusion"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Error, fraud, and corruption (EFC) could undermine the integrity of the digital identification system.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement an end‑to‑end EFC monitoring system, conduct regular audits, enforce access controls and staff training.",
      "evidence": "design and develop an end‑to‑end Error, Fraud, and Corruption (EFC) monitoring system"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delays in verification of Performance‑Based Conditions may postpone disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare verification reports early, establish clear protocols with the Independent Verification Agency, and build verification capacity.",
      "evidence": "decisions over compliance and disbursement against PBCs will be made by the World Bank based on verification reports produced by the Independent Verification Agency (IVA)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Reliance on Excel spreadsheets for financial reporting may cause quality and timeliness issues.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy dedicated financial reporting software, automate IFR generation, and train staff on new tools.",
      "evidence": "use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to challenges in quality and timeliness"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Potential procurement delays for maintenance contracts could affect system upkeep.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Follow the Project Operations Manual, use STEP for tracking, and maintain existing contract management procedures.",
      "evidence": "procurement risk for the project is currently assessed as Low... PMU is requested to elaborate and adopt the POM, including the procurement section"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Improper disposal of electronic devices (mobile units, laptops) may generate e‑waste.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Implement a robust e‑waste management procedure, adopt sustainable procurement, and run awareness campaigns on proper disposal.",
      "evidence": "risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e‑waste and its improper disposal"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Out‑of‑date NPR data could limit rapid response to climate‑related shocks.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Ensure real‑time data updates, integrate NPR with the Disaster Risk Management system, and schedule periodic data refreshes.",
      "evidence": "NPR will provide reliable information on the citizens’ residential location, improving the Government’s ability to identify and reach individuals... quickly during climate‑related shocks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender imbalance may persist if women’s specific barriers are not addressed.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct gender‑sensitive outreach, monitor female enrollment ratios, and adapt communication to address women’s barriers.",
      "evidence": "women’s enrollment is higher than men’s... some strata of the population... are wary of providing their information... risk of exclusion"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Changes in data‑protection legislation could render the system non‑compliant.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain continuous legal monitoring, embed privacy‑by‑design, and update policies promptly to align with new regulations.",
      "evidence": "project will follow national regulations related to personal data protection (Law 09‑08) and incorporate best international practices"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Duplication of budget lines (e.g., AMO‑TADAMON) may cause financial reporting errors.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create distinct budget codes, perform regular reconciliations, and include audit checks for overlapping expenditures.",
      "evidence": "risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO‑TADAMON” to justify expenditure"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Target of >60 % population coverage may not be met, reducing project impact.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Track enrollment KPIs monthly, accelerate outreach where lagging, and allocate additional resources if needed.",
      "evidence": "NPR national rollout strategy aims to expand the system coverage to more than 60 percent of the total population"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Integration challenges between MOSIP platform and existing MoI systems could delay rollout.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct thorough integration testing, adopt a phased deployment, and maintain a dedicated technical support team.",
      "evidence": "MOSIP (Modular Open‑Source Identity Platform) listed among abbreviations indicating platform use"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Coordination delays among ministries within the Inter‑ministerial Steering Committee (IMSC) may slow decision‑making.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Define clear terms of reference, schedule regular IMSC meetings, and establish escalation procedures for urgent matters.",
      "evidence": "IMSC... ensures consistency, validates proposals, monitors progress, assesses challenges, and takes measures for effective implementation"
    }
  ]
}
